text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Losses caused by adverse weather last week amount to some 200 billion lei, the paper said.
- The Agriculture Ministry plans to support farmers who lost their crops following bad weather last week.
- The Tractorul SA tractor maker in Brasov sacked 1,000 workers.
- The Avioane Craiova aircraft maker might sell several IAR 99 training aircraft, the paper said.
- The State Ownership Fund decided to launch a new tender to sell a controlling stake in Otel Inox SA stainless steel maker in Tirgoviste.
- The Agriculture Ministry has funds to buy 500,000 tonnes of milling wheat, the paper said.
